namespace policy = ::mmltk::frameworks::reflection;
struct Manual {
 [[= ::policy::MaxBytes{/* keep rationale */ 8}]] std::string comment;
 [[= unseen::MaxBytes{8}]] std::string unresolved;
 [[= ::policy::MaxBytes{8}]][[= ForeignPolicy{}]] std::string composition;
 [[= ::policy::MaxBytes{8}, ForeignPolicy{}]] std::string combined;
 [[= ::policy::Minimum<Pair<int, float>>{1}]] int comma_type;
#if CHOOSE_POLICY
 [[= ::policy::MaxBytes{8}]] std::string conditional;
#endif
};
